description: 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis (FRED series DTB3), daily, percent per year. Used by de Jong et al. (2009) to pad positions shorter than a month (Tables IV-V) and as the risk-free rate (Table VI).
source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DTB3 (Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.15, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
license: Public domain US government data; FRED terms of use apply. Versioned with DVC like all raw data.
calendar: US business days; FRED marks holidays with '.' (missing)
known_issues: Discount-basis yield, not a bond-equivalent yield; used as a simple annual rate (quant_lab.data.tbill), as in the paper.
